shorts_extract.hook: Changing 'I' to your own first name silently flips panic into coaching — boosting speech performance and calming emotional brainwaves in under one second.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Kross et al. (2014 JPSP, 7 studies) impromptu speech challenge + Moser & Kross (2017 Scientific Reports) sub-second ERP/fMRI proof.
shorts_extract.twist: Why 'effortless' grammatical habit beats willpower-heavy affirmations — and why it works just as strongly for socially anxious people.
